'''Phenter''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
Phenter served under [[General/Legends|General]] [[Greist]] during the [[Cleansing of Nopsin]], alongside [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Pierce]]. The general later promoted Phenter to captain rather than Pierce, but Pierce felt that it was the right decision. By [[3640 BBY]], Greist, Phenter and their men were diverted from the ongoing [[Battle of Corellia]] to [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] by the orders of [[Darth Baras]]. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] did not have the Empire's best interests in mind, however, so [[Servant One]] ordered the [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]] to redirect the soldiers back for [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Greist and Phenter were torn between an order from a [[Dark Council]]or and the Emperor himself, prompting the Wrath to execute Greist. Phenter and [[Armageddon Battalion]] ultimately abandoned Hoth and went to Corellia.<ref name="Reallocation" />
